note: Reusable base answers to common application screening questions. The answer generator tailors these per job. Edit any of these in your own words anytime.

standing_facts.work_authorization: I am a Singapore Citizen and am fully authorized to work in Singapore with no work pass required.

standing_facts.willing_to_relocate: Yes, I am open to relocation.
standing_facts.salary_expectation: Open to discussion / aligned with market rate for the role (leave blank where optional).

standing_facts.disability_status: Prefer not to say / decline to self-identify (choose as you wish).

years_of_experience_rules.including_internships: Approximately 4 months of hands-on data experience via a Data Management internship at the People's Association (May-Sep 2026), plus extensive project-based analytics work.
years_of_experience_rules.specific_tool: State hands-on project + internship usage, not full years. E.g. Python/SQL/Tableau used across internship and multiple analytics projects over the past 2 years of study.

base_narratives.pitch: I am a penultimate-year BSc Data Science and Business Analytics student (University of London / LSE) with hands-on experience in end-to-end data analysis, machine learning, and business intelligence. During my Data Management internship at the People's Association I built an automated Tableau audit dashboard streaming live from FormSG and supported an NLP AI proof of concept on AWS. I work fluently in Python, R, SQL, and Tableau, and I am AWS GenAI certified.
base_narratives.why_data: I enjoy turning messy data into decisions people can act on. Across my internship and projects I have consistently found that a clear dashboard or a well-framed model changes how a team acts, and that impact is what motivates me.
base_narratives.strengths: Strong technical foundation (Python, R, SQL, Tableau, ML/NLP), an eye for data governance and security (CLS/RLS testing during my internship), and the communication skills to translate analysis into business recommendations.
base_narratives.teamwork: Through my Data Analytics Club, Student Council leadership, and competitive fencing, I am used to collaborating under pressure and coordinating stakeholders toward a shared goal.
